People: Giuseppe Garibaldi (author, Wikidata Q539), died 1882; Ernesto Nathan (editor, Wikidata Q969393), died 1921. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Garibaldi, Giuseppe, 1807-1882; Nathan, Ernesto, 1845-1921 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Memorie autobiografiche, Firenze, G. Barbèra, 1888, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/memorieautobiogr00gari. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 50%, 47%, 77% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Ernesto Nathan, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
